art_direction: 墨黑浅杏 · 安静好奇: 墨黑底，浅杏金猫眼微微抬起，神态安静。
composition_variation: Solid soft-black background with no visible texture. Warm pale apricot-gold iris arcs, curved smoothly around black pupils merged with the background. A quiet curious glance toward the left: soft broadly almond eyes, both a little more open than half-lidded but not round circles. One eyelid subtly raised, coordinated sizes and perspective. Elegant tapered gold edges and one small milk-white droplet reflection in each eye. The expression is warm and inviting. No eyebrows, nose, mouth or extra marks. Flat beautiful shapes rather than outlined rings or cut-out discs.
style_inspiration: Two user-provided chat attachments were observed for broad style: minimalist eyes, black or ivory field, sparse color, handmade matte edges. Original expressions and layouts were described in text. No attachment was uploaded as binary model input and no watermark-removal edit was performed.
